blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: When a twelve-lead electrocardiogram is written as text for a large language model, the number of tokens has to be balanced against the information lost through compression. This paper presents a deterministic encoding that writes eight independent leads as amplitude letters and exact time gaps and recovers the remaining four limb leads algebraically. The key points are selected with a cardiac-cycle-dependent tolerance, the amplitudes are parameterized by a 26-letter logarithmic codebook learned from a training set, and a 10-step tolerance schedule keeps all records within a fixed token budget. The encoding was applied to 21,388 records from the public PTB-XL database and evaluated using an exact decode-and-re-encode round trip, waveform reconstruction error, and a paired comparison of convolutional classifiers trained with 5 different seeds on signals from the original and decoded databases. All records were contained in 4,080 tokens (average: 2,866 tokens, 64.3% fewer than a per-sample transcription), and all stored lead strings were exactly reproduced. The average correlation between the decoded and reference signals was 0.982. The macro-averaged area under the receiver operating characteristic curve was 0.9167 for the reference signals and 0.9157 for the decoded signals (paired difference -0.0010; 95% patient-level bootstrap interval, -0.0028 to 0.0007), within the pre-specified non-inferiority margin of -0.010; this is not a confirmatory result, because the test fold had been used during encoder development. The diagnostic content of a compact text can therefore be preserved, while the language model's ability to read the text is yet another matter.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: The electrocardiogram (ECG) is among the most frequently recorded clinical signals, and its 12 standard leads capture the heart’s electrical activity from complementary perspectives. Large language models (LLMs) are being explored as tools that could combine such recordings with clinical text, answer questions about them, or draft reports [ 1 ] . To do so, the waveform must first reach the model in a form it can process. In one route, a dedicated signal encoder produces embeddings that are aligned with the input space of a particular language model [ 2 , 3 ] . In the other, the waveform is written as a sequence of discrete symbols that the model reads like text [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 心电图(ECG)是记录最频繁的临床信号之一,它的12条标准线索从互补的角度捕捉心脏的电活性. 正在探索大型语言模型(LLMs),作为将这种录音与临床文本相结合、回答有关这些问题或起草报告的工具。 为此,波形必须首先以能够处理的形式到达模型. 在一条路由中,专用信号编码器会产生与特定语言模型的输入空间一致的嵌入[2,3]. 在另一种情况下,波形被写成一个离散符号的序列,模型读起来像文本[4,5,6].

blocks.en: Text can be inspected, stored, and passed to different models without a new alignment module, as ECG-aBcDe demonstrates by fine-tuning several language models on a single encoding while keeping their tokenizers unchanged [ 5 ] . Text also has a cost. A ten-second, twelve-lead recording sampled at 100 Hz contains 12,000 voltage values before lead labels, separators, and instructions are added; studies that prompt LLMs with physiological time series show why the numerical format of the input matters [ 7 ] ; and the cost of standard self-attention grows quadratically with sequence length [ 8 ] . An encoding must therefore control the length produced by a real tokenizer while still covering the complete recording.
blocks.zh: 如ECG-aBcDe通过在单一编码上微调几种语言模型,同时保持其标致器不变[5],可以检查,存储并传递给不同的模型,而无需新的对齐模块. 文本也有费用。 在添加铅标签、分离器和说明之前,取样100赫兹的十秒、十二铅记录中包含12,000个电压值;用生理时间序列促进LLMs的研究显示,输入事项的数字格式为何[7];标准自觉成本随序列长度四倍增长[8]。 因此,编码必须控制真实的标注器产生的长度,同时仍然覆盖完整的记录.

blocks.en: Evaluation is another challenge. The diagnostic score of an LLM trained on encoded ECGs combines two factors: the information that was not corrupted during encoding and the model’s ability to effectively utilize the information it was fed. Recent research indicates that the representation of the input can cause the predictions of LLMs to shift [ 9 ] and that a small reconstruction error in the whole can mask the distortion of a short but clinically relevant deflection. What is missing is a protocol for quantifying the information content of an ECG representation in text, independent of any language model. ECG-26c fills that void by encoding each record deterministically as eight labeled lead lines, in which amplitude letters alternate with the exact time gaps between consecutive key points, under an explicitly specified token budget. It asks whether it is possible to record the entire signal without truncation given a fixed context length, how much waveform error is added by the encoding, and whether a classifier trained on the decoded signals will lose some diagnostic information relative to an identical classifier trained on the reference signals.
blocks.zh: 评价是另一项挑战。 对编码ECG进行LLM培训的诊断分数结合了两个因素:编码过程中未损坏的信息和模型有效利用所提供信息的能力。 最近的研究显示,输入的表示可以导致LLMS的预测转移[9],整体上一个小的重建错误可以掩盖短暂但临床相关的偏转的扭曲. 缺少的是在文本中量化ECG代表信息内容的协议,独立于任何语言模式. ECG-26c通过将每个记录定型编码为八条标注的铅线来填补这一空格,其中振幅字母与连续关键点之间的准确时间间隔交替,在明确指定的符号预算下. 它询问是否可以在固定的上下文长度下不截断记录整个信号,编码增加了多少波形错误,在解码信号上受过训练的分类器相对于在参考信号上受过训练的相同分类器是否会丢失一些诊断信息.

blocks.en: This paper makes the following contributions:
blocks.zh: 本文贡献如下:

blocks.en: II Related Work and Background
blocks.zh: 二、相关工作和背景

blocks.en: II-A Background
blocks.zh: A. 背景情况

blocks.en: II-A 1 The ECG is a multichannel time series
blocks.zh: 二级A1 ECG是一个多频道的时间序列

blocks.en: Leads I, II, and III and the augmented leads aVR, aVL, and aVF are obtained from three limb electrodes, whereas V1–V6 come from six chest electrodes. Because the six limb leads share the same electrodes, only two of them are independent; the other four follow from Einthoven’s and Goldberger’s relations. The deflections produced by each heartbeat are typical: P wave, atrial depolarization; QRS complex, ventricular depolarization; T wave, ventricular repolarization. The P and T waves are slower and smaller, and the QRS complex has the steepest changes in the recording and normally lasts less than 0.12 s. Timing is as important as amplitude; e.g., the PR interval has diagnostic value.
blocks.zh: 铅I、II和III以及增强的铅AVR、AVL和AVF来自三个四肢电极,而V1-V6来自六个胸电极。 由于六肢引线共用相同的电极,只有两根电极是独立的;另外四根则跟随了恩特霍芬和戈德伯格的关系. 每个心跳产生的偏转是典型的: P波,原极脱极化;QRS复合体,口腔脱极化;T波,口腔复极化. P波和T波较慢且较小,QRS综合体的录制变化最陡峭,通常持续时间小于0.12 s. 时间安排与振幅同样重要;例如,PR间隔具有诊断价值。

blocks.en: II-A 2 Notation
blocks.zh: II-A 2 注释

An encoder E E maps X X to a string s s , and a decoder D D maps it back to an approximation X ^ = D ⁡ ( s ) \hat{X}=D(s) . Three properties of the pair ( E , D ) (E,D) are explored. Consistency : re-encoding the decoded key points gives back the original string s s ; fidelity : X ^ \hat{X} is close to X X ; sufficiency : a model trained on X ^ \hat{X} performs as well as one trained on X X . Only consistency can be checked exactly; the others must be measured.

blocks.en: II-A 3 Simplification and quantization
blocks.zh: 简化和量化

blocks.en: Polyline simplification keeps only the samples needed to approximate a curve within a tolerance. The Ramer–Douglas–Peucker (RDP) algorithm does this recursively, keeping the point farthest from the current chord at each stage until all the deviations are less than the tolerance [ 10 , 11 ] . Amplitude quantization then maps each retained value to one of a finite set of levels; logarithmic ( μ \mu -law) companding, unlike uniform quantization, uses narrow bins near zero and wide bins at large magnitudes, which is well-suited to signals that cluster around a baseline. Both steps discard information, so a decodable representation is not lossless: decoding yields a single, deterministic approximation of the input.
blocks.zh: 聚线简化仅将所需的样本保存在容积内,以近似曲线. Ramer–Douglas–Peucker(RDP)算法进行这种递归,将点与每个阶段的当前和弦保持最远,直到所有偏差都小于容忍度[10,11]. 振幅量化然后将每个保留值映射到一组有限的水平;对数(μ \ mu - law) companding 与统一的量化不同,它使用接近0的狭小的垃圾桶和巨大的宽的垃圾桶,这非常适合围绕基线集群的信号. 两个步骤都丢弃了信息,因此可解码的表示不无损失:解码产生一个单一的,决定性的输入近似值.

blocks.en: II-B Related Studies
blocks.zh: 二-B 相关研究

blocks.en: II-B 1 ECG–language models built on learned encoders
blocks.zh: II-B 1 ECG-语言模型基于学习的编码器

blocks.en: A signal encoder can be linked to a language model via learned projections, as in [ 2 , 3 ] , and the ECG representation can be pretrained from cardiological text using a language model, as in [ 12 ] ; a recent survey puts these systems into context with the rest of the ECG literature [ 1 ] . They take advantage of abundant connections between waveforms and clinical terms. Still, the continuous embedding they pass to the language model cannot be read or decoded into a waveform, and the alignment must be repeated for every new model.
blocks.zh: 信号编码器可以通过学习预测与语言模型连接,如[2,3],ECG代表可以使用语言模型从心脏病学文本中预先培训,如[12];最近的一项调查将这些系统与ECG文献的其余部分联系起来[1]. 它们利用波形和临床术语之间的大量联系。 尽管如此,它们传递到语言模型的连续嵌入无法读取或解码为波形,每个新模型都必须重复对齐.

blocks.en: II-B 2 Symbolic and learned vocabularies
blocks.zh: II-B 2 符号和学习词汇

blocks.en: SAX maps segment averages to equiprobable symbols [ 13 ] , and LLM-ABBA approximates a series with adaptive linear pieces before symbolizing them for language models [ 14 ] . In ECGs, ECGBERT is trained using self-supervised learning to obtain representations from segments considered as words [ 15 ] ; ECG-Byte quantizes the signal and learns byte-pair encoding (BPE) merges [ 16 ] on the resulting strings to get a waveform-specific tokenizer [ 4 ] ; HeartLLM quantizes the lead-wise waveform and extends the vocabulary, and it pretrains the language model before instruction tuning [ 6 ] . Learned vocabularies are efficient to store; however, symbols in the vocabulary do not have an innate physical meaning, and the number of tokens depends on vocabularies that differ between studies.
blocks.zh: LLM-ABBA绘制了一组具有适应性的线性片段,然后才作为语言模型的符号[14]。 在ECGs中,ECGBERT通过自我监督的学习来获得从被认为是单词的片段的表示力来进行训练[15];ECG-Byte对信号进行定量,并学习字节-pair编码(BPE)在产生的字符串上合并[16],以获得一个波形特定的标注符[4];HeartLLM对领先的波形进行定量并扩展词汇,在指令调音[6]前它预示语言模型. 学到的词汇可以有效存储;然而,词汇中的符号不具有固有物理意义,符号的数量取决于不同研究的词汇.

blocks.en: II-B 3 Fixed alphabets with physical meaning
blocks.zh: II-B 3 具有物理意义的固定字母表

blocks.en: ECG-aBcDe selects breakpoints with ℓ \ell 1 trend filtering [ 17 ] , writes the amplitude at each breakpoint as a lowercase letter and the elapsed time as an uppercase letter, and passes the text to unmodified language models [ 5 ] . Because each letter stands for a fixed bin, the text can be decoded into an approximate waveform. The published method, however, quantizes time gaps into equal-frequency bins, writes all twelve leads, and truncates inputs at 4,096 tokens, so the end of a long recording can be lost.
blocks.zh: ECG-aBcDe 选择带有 l\ell 1 趋势过滤 [17] 的断点,将每个断点的振幅写成小写字母,将过去的时间写成大写字母,并将文本传递给未修改的语言模型 [5]. 因为每个字母代表一个固定的bin,所以文本可以解码成一个大概的波形. 然而,公布的方法将时间间隔量化为等频的bin,写出所有十二条线索,并将输入调值为4,096令牌,因此长录音的结尾可能会丢失.

blocks.en: II-B 4 Evaluating what a representation preserves
blocks.zh: 二级B级 4 评价说明保留的内容

blocks.en: The weighted diagnostic distortion measure was proposed because the percentage root-mean-square difference can remain small even when clinically important features are altered [ 18 ] . On PTB-XL, benchmark studies provide deep-learning baselines for the diagnostic superclasses [ 19 ] , and subsequent work reports that 100-Hz inputs perform as well as 500-Hz inputs [ 20 ] . These benchmarks evaluate classifiers, not representations.
blocks.zh: 提出加权诊断扭曲措施的原因是,即使临床上重要的特征被改变,根-正-平方差百分比仍然很小。 关于PTB-XL,基准研究为诊断超类提供了深层学习基线[19],随后的工作报告显示,100赫兹的投入以及500赫兹的投入都发挥了作用[20]。 这些基准评价的是分类者,而不是表述。

blocks.en: II-C Research Gap
blocks.zh: II-C 研究差距

blocks.en: The reviewed approaches are summarized in Table I , which shows how ECG information is delivered to the language model, either via continuous embeddings, learned vocabularies, or fixed symbolic alphabets. The results of these studies do not show directly how much of the waveform information reaches the language model through these representations. The key to successful report generation or question answering is ensuring that the information in the input is correctly interpreted by the language model. The task of separating these two factors is still an important methodological problem.
blocks.zh: 所审查的方法摘要载于表一,其中显示如何通过连续嵌入、学习词汇或固定符号字母向语言模型提供ECG信息。 这些研究成果并没有直接显示波形信息通过这些表示方式到达语言模型的多少. 成功生成报告或回答问题的关键是确保输入中的信息被语言模型正确解释. 将这两个因素分开的任务仍然是一个重要的方法问题。

blocks.en: ECG-aBcDe is relevant because each of its amplitude (lowercase) and duration (uppercase) letters stands for a fixed bin, so the ECG waveform can be reconstructed from the text. Its published evaluation focuses on question answering, and the authors also report timing distortions that arise during reconstruction, which they reduce by peak-alignment-based resampling [ 5 ] . The disadvantage of this, however, is that if time intervals are divided into equal-frequency bins, timing errors can add up, distorting or shifting the reconstructed waveform. One problem yet to be solved is how to shorten a full multilead recording while minimizing alterations to the sample locations of the retained key points. ECG-26c can overcome this problem by using a precise count of samples between key points. So it eliminates temporal quantization as a source of reconstruction errors, but still has lossy amplitude quantization and interpolation.
blocks.zh: ECG-aBcDe之所以相关,是因为其振幅(小写)和时长(大写)字母代表一个固定的bin,所以ECG波形可以从文字中重建. 其公布的评价侧重于回答问题,作者们还报告了重建过程中出现的时间扭曲现象,他们通过基于峰值的重新标注来减少时间扭曲[5]. 然而,其缺点是,如果时间间隔被划分为等频箱,计时错误可以加起来,扭曲或转移重建的波形. 一个有待解决的问题是如何缩短完整的多头记录,同时尽量减少对保留关键点的抽样地点的改变。 ECG-26c可以通过在关键点之间精确计数样本来克服这个问题. 因此它消除了时间量化作为重建错误的来源,但仍有损失的振幅量化和内插.

blocks.en: Another challenge is writing full recordings within a given token budget. There is no one-to-one mapping between sequence length (in characters or symbols) and the number of language-model tokens; if the sequence exceeds the model’s context length, the rest is truncated. Length control should be applied during encoding and should use the tokenizer of the desired language model. The signal-text budget also has to be kept separate from the instructions and outputs during evaluation. When all recordings in a dataset fit within the signal-text budget, unseen recordings from the same source are likely to fit as well, but this is not guaranteed, and full downstream prompts still have to be counted separately.
blocks.zh: 另一项挑战是在一定的象征性预算中写完整录音。 序列长度(以字符或符号表示)和语言模型符号数量之间没有一对一的映射;如果序列超过模型的上下文长度,则其余部分被截断. 长度控制应当在编码过程中应用,并应当使用理想语言模型的表示器. 在评价期间,信号文本预算也必须与指示和产出分开。 当一个数据集中的所有录音都符合信号文本预算时,来自同一来源的未见录音也有可能适合,但这并不得到保证,完整的下游提示仍然必须分别计算.

blocks.en: Waveform similarity is also not enough to show that diagnostic information is preserved. Global reconstruction measures can mask short informative deflections [ 18 ] , and language model scores are sensitive to model capacity, training, and task formulation. A complementary evaluation is performed between classifiers trained with the filtered reference signal and the decoded signals, under matched data and training conditions. When assessing uncertainty in the paired performance difference, it is possible to evaluate the contribution of the encoding to a measurable loss in the diagnostic task in question.
blocks.zh: 波形相似性也不足以表明诊断信息得到保存. 全球重建措施可以掩盖信息短促的偏移[18],语言模型分数对模型能力,培训和任务制定很敏感. 在经过过滤的参考信号培训的分类人员与经解码的信号之间,在匹配的数据和培训条件下,进行补充评价。 在评估配对性能差异的不确定性时,可以评价编码对相关诊断任务可计量损失的贡献.

blocks.en: ECG-26c combines all these requirements into a fixed-amplitude codebook with exact sample-gap encoding, plus a paired 5-seed classifier evaluation, and provides tokenizer-based length control. Before any language model is trained, its contribution is the joint evaluation of codec consistency, waveform fidelity, and diagnostic information. This evaluation is used to describe the amount of representation loss in the classifier family and the tested data set. It does not establish clinical equivalence or demonstrate that a language model can retrieve the retained information from the symbolic text.
blocks.zh: ECG-26c将所有这些要求合并成一个有精确样本-gap编码的固定模版代码簿,加上一对5种种子的分类器评价,并提供了基于指示器的长度控制. 在培训任何语言模型之前,其贡献是对编码一致性、波形忠诚度和诊断信息的联合评价。 本评价用于描述分类者家族和测试数据集中代表损失的金额. 它没有确立临床等同性,也没有证明语言模型能够从符号文本中获取保留的信息.

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en: III-A Overview of the Proposed Approach
blocks.zh: 三-A 拟议办法概述

blocks.en: As Fig. 1 shows, a record is first filtered and reduced to its eight independent leads. For each lead, key points are selected with tolerances that depend on their position within the cardiac cycle; their amplitudes are mapped to letters; and the gaps between them are written as exact sample counts. If the text exceeds the token budget, key points are selected again at a coarser tolerance level. The decoder reverses the serialization, interpolates between key points, and rebuilds the four omitted limb leads.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,记录首先被过滤,并减为8条独立线索. 对于每个铅,关键点的选取取决于它们在心脏循环中的位置的耐受性;它们的振幅被映射成字母;它们之间的空隙被写成精确的样本计数. 如果文本超过符号预算,关键点会在较窄的容忍度水平上再次选择. 解码器反转序列化,在关键点之间插图,重建四个省略的四肢线索.

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Encoder (top) and decoder (bottom) of ECG-26c. The tolerance level k starts at 0 and increases only when the serialized text exceeds the token budget; decoding requires the frozen codebook and the format conventions but no learned model.
blocks.zh: 图1:ECG-26c的编码器(上部)和解码器(下部). 容忍级别 k 始于 0 , 仅在序列化文本超过符号预算时才会增加; 解码需要被冻结的代码簿和格式常规, 但是没有学到的模型 。

blocks.en: ECG-26c inherits from ECG-aBcDe the idea of alternating amplitude and time letters but changes most other design decisions (Table II ). The comparison concerns design, not performance, since the two methods were developed with different data and tasks.

blocks.en: III-B Preprocessing and Lead Reduction
blocks.zh: 三-B 预处理和减少铅

blocks.en: Each lead is centered by subtracting its median, then filtered with a third-order Butterworth high-pass filter (cut-off 0.5 Hz), applied forwards and backwards, which removes baseline wander without phase distortion. The filtered signal serves as the reference for all fidelity measures, so the loss due to the encoding is isolated from the filter’s effect.
blocks.zh: 每条铅都是通过减去其中位数而居中,然后用三阶巴特沃思高通滤波器(截断0.5Hz)进行过滤,向前和向后应用,这可以消除基线漂移而不发生相位扭曲. 过滤过的信号作为所有忠贞度量的参考,因此编码引起的损失与过滤器的效果是隔离的.

In the stored PTB-XL data, the identities hold to within about 1.5 μ \mu V for almost every record; the 63 records that deviate by more than 2 μ \mu V are excluded in a sensitivity analysis (Section V-A ).

blocks.en: III-C Encoding and Decoding
blocks.zh: 三-C 编码和解码

blocks.en: III-C 1 Cardiac-cycle-dependent key points
blocks.zh: III-C 1 依赖心循环的关键点

blocks.en: QRS complexes are located on a multi-lead energy signal e ⁡ [ n ] e[n] , obtained by band-pass filtering all 12 leads (5–15 Hz), taking the Euclidean norm across leads at each sample, and smoothing the result with a 5-sample moving average. Beats are those peaks that have an amplitude of at least 30% of the 99th percentile of e ⁡ [ n ] e[n] and occur with at least 0.33 s separation. Then each sample receives a tolerance ε ⁡ [ n ] \varepsilon[n] , which depends on the position of the sample relative to the nearest beat; at the default setting, ε ⁡ [ n ] \varepsilon[n] is 0.02 mV for samples between − - 100 and +120 ms from the maximum (QRS complex), 0.03 mV for samples between − - 300 and − - 100 ms (P wave and PR segment), 0.04 mV for samples between +130 and +500 ms (ST segment and T wave), and 0.06 mV for all other samples. The QRS complex has the tightest tolerance because it has a short duration and steep deflections, which would otherwise be the first to be simplified. The windows are fixed offsets around detected peaks rather than around annotated wave boundaries.

The tolerance bounds the piecewise-linear approximation before quantization; it does not bound the final decoded error, which also includes contributions from quantization and lead reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 并且以同样的方式处理所产生的两个小块,直到没有出现正的多余。 耐受性在定量前将片断-线性近似值绑定;它不绑定最终解码错误,其中也包括定量和铅重建的贡献.

blocks.zh: III-C 2 振幅字母表

blocks.en: Very large deflections would otherwise be clipped by the outer letters. If any key point of a lead falls more than 0.25 mV outside the decoded range, the lead is written at half or quarter scale with the prefix x2 or x4 , and the decoder multiplies its values by 2 or 4. In the evaluated corpus, 1,653 records have at least one scaled lead.
blocks.zh: 否则,外部字母会切断非常大的偏转。 如果某一铅的任何关键点在解码范围以外坠落超过0.25 mV,则铅以半或四分之一比例写成前缀x2或x4,解码器将其值乘以2或4. 在评估的档案中,有1 653份记录至少有一份显示领先。

blocks.en: III-C 3 Time gaps, serialization and length control
blocks.zh: III-C 3 时间间隔、序列化和长度控制

blocks.en: The gap d between consecutive key points is expressed in samples. The letters A–Z represent gaps of 1–26 samples; a longer gap is written as a run of Z letters followed by the letter for the remainder, and the decoder adds consecutive time letters. Two amplitude letters in a row mean a one-sample step, which is common in steep deflections. Unlike equal-frequency time bins, exact timing ensures that each retained key point is returned to its original sample position.
blocks.zh: d 连续关键点之间的差距用样品表示。 字母A–Z代表1–26个样本的空隙;较长的空隙被写成Z字母的运行,后面是其余的字母,解码器会添加连续的时间字母. 连续两个振幅字母表示一个一模一样的步骤,这在陡度偏移中很常见. 与等频时间箱不同,准确的时间可以确保每个保留的关键点返回到其原始的样本位置.

blocks.en: Symbols are separated by spaces, and each of the eight lines starts with its corresponding lead label (I, II, V1, …, V6). The unmodified Qwen2.5 tokenizer [ 21 ] is used to measure length. With a 4,096-token context, the signal text can contain at most 4,080 tokens; the remaining 16 tokens cannot hold instructions or answers, so a downstream study must count the complete input of the fully assembled context. A record that is too long at a given level is re-encoded at the next of ten tolerance levels (level 9 uses 0.15, 0.20, 0.30, and 0.50 mV for the four segment types); if it is still too long at level 9, building the dataset stops with an explicit error.
blocks.zh: 符号按空格分隔,八行各以相应的铅标签(I,II,V1,.,V6)开头. 未修改的 Quen2.5 符号化器 [21] 用于测量长度. 在4,096个托肯上下文的情况下,信号文本最多可以包含4,080个令牌;其余16个令牌不能持有指令或答案,所以下游研究必须计算完整组装上下文的完整输入. 一个在一个特定级别上时间太长的记录,在10个容忍级别(9级使用0.15,0.20,0.30和0.50 mV的4个区段类型)的下一个级别重新编码;如果在9级仍然太长,则以明显的错误构建数据集停止.

blocks.en: III-C 4 Decoding and a worked example
blocks.zh: 三-C 4 解码和实例

blocks.en: Decoding does the opposite: amplitude letters are transformed to codebook values, and any gain factor is applied; time letters are added together to form sample positions; values between key points are linearly interpolated; and Eq. ( 1 ) restores the limb leads. No neural decoder is involved. Re-encoding the decoded key points produces the original string, which verifies the codec but not the original voltages.
blocks.zh: 解码则相反:振幅字母转换为代码本值,并应用任何增益因子;时间字母加在一起形成样本位置;关键点之间的值是线性插值;以及Eq. (1)恢复四肢线索. 没有涉及神经解码器。 重新编码解码的密钥点产生原弦,该弦对编码器进行验证,但不对原电压进行验证.

blocks.en: III-D Computational Cost
blocks.zh: 三-D 计算费用

blocks.en: Encoding is dominated by key-point selection and token counting; the recursive RDP search is, at worst, quadratic in the number of samples in a lead, and only records that exceed the budget are encoded more than once. Decoding needs only table look-ups and linear interpolation. Both arms of the downstream experiment use the same network and take about 219 s per run on a single NVIDIA T4 GPU. The benefit of shorter text lies outside the classifier: because attention cost grows with input length, fewer tokens make language-model training and inference cheaper.
blocks.zh: 编码以键点选择和符号计数为主;递归式的RDP搜索最糟糕的是,在领先的样本数量上是四进制,只有超过预算的记录被编码不止一次. 解码只需要表的查看和线性插值. 下游实验的两臂都使用相同的网络,在单NVIDIA T4 GPU上每跑约需要219s. 较短的文字的好处在分类器之外:因为注意成本随着输入长度的增加而增加,较少的符号使得语言模型培训和推论更便宜.

blocks.en: IV Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 四 实验设置

blocks.en: IV-A Dataset
blocks.zh: IV-A 数据集

blocks.en: The experiments use PTB-XL version 1.0.3 [ 22 ] , a public database of 21,799 ten-second, twelve-lead ECGs from 18,869 patients. In the 100-Hz release, every record is a 12 × \times 1,000 matrix in millivolts. Records that carried at least one of the 44 diagnostic statements of the SCP-ECG standard were retained, resulting in 21,388 records from 18,617 patients. They were labeled with the five diagnostic superclasses of PTB-XL, namely normal ECG (NORM), myocardial infarction (MI), ST/T change (STTC), conduction disturbance (CD), and hypertrophy (HYP), using the standard aggregation at any likelihood; a record may therefore carry several labels.
blocks.zh: 实验使用PTB-XL版本1.0.3[22],一个公共数据库,由来自18,869个病人的21,799个十秒,十二铅ECG组成. 在100赫兹的发行中,每张记录都是12×\\times1000矩阵的milivolts. 载有SCP-ECG标准44份诊断说明中至少一份的记录被保留下来,结果有来自18,617位病人的21,388份记录. 它们被贴上了PTB-XL的五个诊断超级,即正常ECG(NORM)、心肌梗塞(MI)、ST/T变化(STTC)、导电扰动(CD)和超营养(HYP)的标签,并使用标准聚合;因此,记录可能带有若干标签。

blocks.en: The recommended patient-wise split assigns folds 1–8 to training (17,084 records), fold 9 to validation (2,146 records), and fold 10 to testing (2,158 records from 1,877 patients), with no patient in more than one split. The test fold contains 963 NORM, 550 MI, 521 STTC, 496 CD, and 262 HYP positives. All arms share the same records, labels, and preprocessing, so differences between them cannot be attributed to the data.
blocks.zh: 推荐的患者分档分配1-8分数用于培训(17 084份记录),9分数用于验证(2 146份记录),10分数用于测试(1 877名患者的2 158份记录),一个以上的分档没有病人。 测试折叠包含963 NORM,550 MI,521 STTC,496 CD,以及262 HYP阳性. 所有武器都拥有相同的记录、标签和预处理,因此它们之间的差异不能归因于数据。

blocks.en: IV-B Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 四-B 评价计量

blocks.en: Codec integrity. Every record was decoded and re-encoded; the regenerated lead strings were compared character by character with the stored ones, and token counts were recomputed.
blocks.zh: 代码完整性。 每张唱片都被解码和重新编码;重新生成的铅字串被按照字符与存储的字符进行比较,并重新计算符号数.

blocks.en: IV-C Baselines and Paired Design
blocks.zh: 基线和设计

blocks.en: The main comparison is internal: the reference arm trains a classifier on the filtered signal, and the decoded arm trains the same classifier on the signal decoded from ECG-26c text. To isolate each design component, all records were also encoded using the same codebook in six fixed variants: every sample quantized without key-point selection (quantization only), a uniform RDP tolerance of 0.02 mV, and tolerance levels of 0, 3, 6, and 9 applied without the budget rule. No published ECG text method was re-implemented; those systems are compared by design only (Table II ).
blocks.zh: 主要比较为内部:参考臂在过滤信号上列车一个分类器,解码臂在从ECG-26c文本解码的信号上列车一个相同的分类器. 为了隔离每个设计组件,所有记录也使用同一个编码本在六个固定变体中编码:每个样本在不选择关键点的情况下进行定量(只量化),统一的RDP容积为0.02 mV,容积为0,3,6和9,没有预算规则. 没有重新实施已公布的ECG文本方法;仅按设计对这些系统进行比较(表二)。

blocks.en: The classifier is a one-dimensional residual convolutional neural network (CNN): a stem convolution (kernel 7, stride 2, 16 channels), four residual blocks widening to 32, 64, 64 and 128 channels (kernel 5, batch normalization, ReLU), concatenated global average and max pooling, dropout of 0.2 and a five-unit output layer, with 221,477 parameters in total. It was chosen from 12 configurations using only the reference arm, so any advantage from model selection lies with the reference. Training minimized binary cross-entropy with AdamW (weight decay 0.01) under a one-cycle learning-rate schedule peaking at 3 × 10 − 3 3\times 10^{-3} , using batches of 64 for 30 epochs without augmentation. The checkpoint with the highest validation macro-AUROC was retained, and per-class thresholds that maximized validation F1 were applied unchanged to the test fold. For each seed (0–4), the two arms shared their initial weights and the mini-batch order.
blocks.zh: 分类器是一维残存的转录神经网络(CNN):干支转录(内核7,步长2,16通道),四个残块拓宽到32,64,64和128通道(内核5,批量正常化,ReLU),调和全球平均和最大集合,0.2和5单元输出层的退出,共221,477个参数. 它是从仅使用参考臂的12个配置中选择的,因此模型选择的任何优势都在于参考. 根据一个单一周期的学习率表,培训尽量减少与AdamW(重量衰减0.01)的二进制,峰值为3×10 − 3+Times 10×3 → 3},使用批次的64分,用于30个没有增强的时代。 保留了最高验证宏-AUROC的检查站,并且对测试折叠版不加修改地适用了最大限度验证F1的每级阈值. 每根种子(0-4),两只手臂共享其初始重量和小批量顺序.

blocks.en: Uncertainty was quantified using 10,000 patient-cluster bootstrap replicates of the test fold, in which patients, rather than records, are resampled and both arms share the same draws [ 23 , 24 ] . The decoded arm is declared non-inferior if the lower bound of the two-sided 95% interval for Δ \Delta lies above − - 0.010, following the paired-AUC framework of Liu et al. [ 25 ] . This margin is an analytic tolerance, not a clinical acceptance threshold. It was recorded on 30 September 2026, and the analysis plan was frozen on 14 October 2026 before any model for this experiment was trained; however, earlier encoder development had used fold 10 (Section V-D ). Secondary metrics are not corrected for multiple comparisons, and the fixed-variant results are exploratory.
blocks.zh: 不确定性是使用10 000个病人-组群靴子复制的试验折叠物量化的,其中病人而非记录被重新取样,两只手臂共用同样的图[23、24]。 解码臂被宣布为非硬臂,如果双侧95%的间隔的下限为QQ\Delta位于−-0.010上方,遵循刘等人的配对-AUC框架[25]. 这种比值是一种分析耐受性,而不是临床接受阈值. 其记录于2026年9月30日,分析计划于2026年10月14日被冻结,在此之前任何用于此实验的模型都接受了训练;然而,早期的编码器开发使用了折叠10(第V-D节). 二级度量衡在进行多项比较时不进行校正,固定变量结果为探索性.

blocks.en: IV-D Experimental Environment
blocks.zh: IV-D 实验环境

blocks.en: The experiments used Python 3.13, NumPy 2.4, SciPy 1.17, pandas 3.0, scikit-learn 1.9, and PyTorch 2.11 with CUDA 13.0 on an NVIDIA Tesla T4 GPU.

blocks.en: V Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: V-A Main Results
blocks.zh: 主要成果

blocks.en: Codec integrity and text length. All 171,104 stored lead strings (21,388 records × \times 8 leads) were reproduced exactly, and all ten fold files were rebuilt from the raw PTB-XL files with matching contents. The average (median) number of tokens per record was 2,866 (2,795), with a 95th percentile of 3,880 and a maximum of 4,080. No record was truncated, and 94.1% of records were written at level 0. The symbol count is close to the token count, with 1.01 symbols per space-separated token.

blocks.en: Signal fidelity. The average r value between the decoded signals and the filtered reference was 0.982. The median PRDN was 12.7% for all 12 leads, 11.4% for the stored leads, and 20.6% for the rebuilt leads, indicating that errors in leads I and II are compounded in the derived leads. A typical reconstruction is depicted in Fig. 4 ; the amplitudes and shapes of the QRS complexes and T waves are retained, and the small baseline fluctuations are smoothed.

blocks.en: Diagnostic information. The two arms in the test fold are compared in Table IV . The macro-AUROC was 0.9167 ± \pm 0.0014 (mean ± \pm SD over seeds) for the reference and 0.9157 ± \pm 0.0010 for the decoded signal. The lower limit of the 95% interval for the paired difference is well above the pre-specified margin of − - 0.010, so the decoded arm is non-inferior, and the interval includes zero. The seed-to-seed standard deviation of the paired difference (0.0014) exceeded the mean difference itself. The CNN is compact rather than state-of-the-art: deeper PTB-XL benchmark models achieve superclass macro-AUROC values of roughly 0.92–0.93 [ 19 ] .

Micro-AUROC and MI AUROC decreased with intervals that exclude zero, and the mean per-seed MI F1 score fell by 0.013. Averaging the five seeds into an ensemble also revealed a small macro-AUROC loss ( Δ \Delta = − - 0.0023; 95% interval − - 0.0042 to − - 0.0003). blocks.en: V-B Ablation Study
blocks.zh: V-B 读取研究

blocks.en: In Table V and Fig. 5 , the contributions of amplitude quantization, key-point selection, and the budget rule are separated. Quantization without key-point selection, which discards no samples, gives a median PRDN of 11.7% at a cost of 8,029 tokens per record. A uniform RDP tolerance of 0.02 mV reduces the number of tokens by more than half with similar fidelity, but the longest records still need more than 7,000 tokens. Cycle-dependent tolerances at level 0 save a further 19% with a modest increase in error, but about 6% of records still exceed 4,080 tokens. The budget rule removes this tail: these records are re-encoded at coarser levels, which caps the maximum at 4,080 tokens per record without changing the median PRDN.
blocks.zh: 在表五和图5中,振幅量化、关键点选择和预算规则的贡献是分开的。 无键点选择的量化,不丢弃样本,每张记录以8,029个令牌的价格给出11.7%的中位PRDN. 统一的RDP耐用度为0.02 mV,使得信使数量减少了一半以上,具有相似的忠诚度,但最长的记录仍然需要超过7000个信使. 0级的周期依赖耐受性又节省了19%,误差略有增加,但约6%的记录仍然超过4,080个令牌. 预算规则去掉这一尾巴:这些记录以较粗的级别重新编码,最高上限为每张记录4,080个令牌,而不改变中位数PRDN.

blocks.en: Coarser fixed levels trace the trade-off. At level 3 the error rises noticeably, yet the change in macro-AUROC cannot be distinguished from zero. A detectable loss appears at level 6, while level 9 crosses the margin. Level 6 thus separates a statistical loss from a violation of non-inferiority: its whole interval lies below zero, so information is lost, but not enough to breach the chosen margin. Because these comparisons use the test fold, they describe the trade-off and should not be used to select a new operating level.
blocks.zh: 煤炭固定水平追踪取舍. 在三级,错误明显上升,但宏观AUROC的变化不能与零区分开来. 可探测的损失出现在第6级,而第9级则跨越了差值。 因此,第6级将统计损失与违反非任意性区分开来:其整个间隔位于零以下,因此信息丢失,但不足以突破选定的差值. 因为这些比较使用测试折叠,它们描述了权衡,不应用于选择新的操作级别.

blocks.en: V-C Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: The small losses were all in myocardial infarction. A possible explanation, not directly tested here, is that brief deflections, such as pathological “Q” waves (only a few samples at 100 Hz), are small and can fall within the tolerance or a single amplitude bin. A wave-level audit is consistent with that, showing that among detectable waves, 2.0% of Q waves were missing after decoding, while 0.08% of R waves and 0.04% of T waves were missing.
blocks.zh: 这些小损失都发生在心肌梗塞中。 一种可能的解释不是在这里直接测试的,是短暂的偏移,如病理的“Q”波(只有100赫兹的几个样本)是小的,可以属于耐受性或单个振幅本. 浪级审计与此一致,显示在可探测波中,解码后Q波缺失2.0%,而R波缺失0.08%,T波缺失0.04%.

blocks.en: Reconstruction error as a proxy. Record-level error did not predict how much a record’s predictions changed: the Spearman correlation between record-level PRDN and the mean absolute change in predicted probability was − - 0.08 (n = 2,158), statistically detectable but negligible. Together with the absence of loss at level 3, this agrees with the long-standing argument that PRD-type measures do not capture diagnostic distortion [ 18 ] . Text representations of ECGs should therefore be judged by direct tests of diagnostic content rather than by fidelity thresholds.
blocks.zh: 作为代理重构错误 。 记录级错误没有预测记录的预测变化有多大:记录级PRDN与预测概率的平均绝对变化之间的斯皮尔曼关系是−-0.08(n = 2,158),统计学上可以探测但可以忽略不计. 加上第3级没有损失,这与长期以来关于PRD类措施不能捕捉诊断性扭曲的说法一致. [18]. 因此,应根据对诊断内容的直接测试而不是忠诚阈值来判断ECG的文字表述。

blocks.en: Compression metadata as a shortcut. Coarser levels were needed more often for abnormal records: 7.4–10.8% of records in the four disease classes required a level above 0, compared with 2.45% of NORM records. Fast rhythms and noisy recordings generate more key points, so the pattern is expected, but the level and the gain markers are visible in the text, and a language model could exploit them as shortcuts. Downstream experiments should withhold the level from the prompt or stratify their results by level.
blocks.zh: 压缩元数据作为快捷键. 对异常记录来说,更经常地需要收缩器水平:在四种疾病类别中,7.4%-10.8%的记录要求水平高于0,而NORM记录的2.45%。 快速节奏和吵闹的录音产生更多的关键点,所以图案是预期的,但关卡和增益标记在文本中是可见的,一个语言模型可以把它们作为捷径来利用. 下游实验应当将水平与即时水平隔开,或者按照水平分级测定结果.

blocks.en: Implications for language-model studies. The token counts reported here depend on the Qwen2.5 tokenizer and cannot be compared directly with those of ECG-Byte, whose vocabulary is trained on ECG strings [ 4 ] , or of ECG-aBcDe, which does not report token counts [ 5 ] . The distinctive element of this study is its evaluation, which measures information loss before any language model is involved. A non-inferior CNN, which receives an interpolated waveform, shows that the information is present in the text, not that a language model can extract it from letters. In an earlier project audit, an order-free classifier using only per-lead symbol frequencies reached a test macro-AUROC of about 0.87; future language-model results should beat such baselines to show that they exploit the temporal structure of the text.
blocks.zh: 对语言模式研究的影响。 这里报告的符号计数取决于Quen2.5的符号,不能直接与ECG-Byte的符号比较,ECG-Byte的词汇被训练为ECG字符串[4],或者ECG-aBcde的符号计数,它不报告符号计数[5]. 这项研究的独特内容是评价,在涉及任何语言模式之前,评估信息损失。 接受内插波形的非 inferior CNN显示信息存在于文本中,而不是一个语言模型可以从字母中提取. 在较早的项目审计中,一个只使用每个铅符号频率的无订单分类器达到了约0.87的测试宏AUROC;未来的语言模型结果应当比这些基线更强,以表明它们利用文本的时间结构。

blocks.en: V-D Limitations
blocks.zh: V-D限制

blocks.en: The main limitation is that the test fold was partly exposed during development. The tolerances, filter type, and quantizer type were selected on the first 100 labeled records of fold 10. The previous CNN validation also included fold 10, and the label-based cross-validation used the first 100 labeled records of every fold. The frozen paired protocol controls the comparison between the arms but cannot undo these earlier decisions, so the result is a structured re-estimation that must be confirmed on independent data.
blocks.zh: 主要限制是测试折叠在开发过程中被部分曝光. 在Flack 10的前100个标签记录中选择了耐受性,滤波器类型,以及量子类型. 之前的CNN验证还包括折叠10,基于标签的交叉验证使用了每个折叠的第一个100个标签记录. 被冻结的配对协议控制着武器之间的比较,但无法推翻这些先前的决定,因此结果是在独立数据上必须加以确认的结构化重新评估。

blocks.en: The evidence is for one dataset, five broad superclasses, and a compact CNN family; more powerful classifiers could show losses that this model does not, and the impact of the 0.5-Hz filter itself is not quantified. The rebuilt limb leads have nearly twice the relative error of the original leads, and the smallest beat distance is 0.33 s (180 bpm), which could merge beats in faster rhythms. Lastly, the outer amplitude bins are open-ended, so values in them can be coded with errors of up to 0.7 mV, and 16 records exceed the coded range even at quarter scale.
blocks.zh: 证据是用于一个数据集,五个大超级,以及一个紧凑的CNN家族;更强大的分类器可以显示这个模型没有的损失,0.5-Hz滤波器本身的影响也没有量化. 重建后的四肢铅有近两倍于原铅的相对误差,最小的节拍距离为0.33秒(180 bpm),这可以以更快的节奏合并节拍. 最后,外振幅宾箱是开放式的,因此其中的值可以编码出高达0.7 mV的错误,16个记录甚至超过了四分之一尺度的编码范围.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en: This paper showed how a twelve-lead ECG can be written as compact, decodable text and how the information retained in that text can be measured without a language model. ECG-26c writes eight leads as amplitude letters and exact time gaps, selects key points with heartbeat-dependent tolerances, and adapts its tolerance level so that every PTB-XL record fits within 4,080 Qwen2.5 tokens. Across 21,388 records, the codec was exactly consistent, and the mean token count was roughly one-third of that for a per-sample transcription. In a paired five-seed CNN experiment, the decoded signals were non-inferior on macro-AUROC; the losses in micro-AUROC and in the MI class were small but detectable and stayed within the margin. At the same time, the ablation indicated that reconstruction error is a poor predictor of diagnostic loss. The main lesson for practitioners is that representation fidelity, diagnostic sufficiency, and language-model capability are distinct properties and therefore require different tests. Three directions follow. First, the design choices should be repeated on the training data only and checked on an independent dataset. Second, the representation should be improved where it is weakest (the open outer amplitude bins, small deflections such as Q waves, and fast rhythms). Third, language models should be fine-tuned on ECG-26c text with the full context counted, compared against order-free symbol-frequency baselines, and tested for shortcuts through compression levels and gain markers. These are only computational comparisons and would not be sufficient for clinical use.
blocks.zh: 该文件说明了如何将12个牵头ECG写成紧凑、可解码的文本,以及如何在没有语言模式的情况下衡量该文本中保留的信息。 ECG-26c将8个线索写成振幅字母和准确的时间间隔,用心跳依赖的容忍度选择关键点,并调整其容忍度水平,使每张PTB-XL记录都符合4,080 Quen2.5令牌. 在21,388个记录中,解码器完全一致,平均符号计数大约是每个样本的三分之一。 在一个配对的五种子CNN实验中,解码信号在宏观AUROC上是非致命的;在微观AUROC和MI级中,损失很小,但可探测,并停留在边际内. 同时,衰减表明重建错误对诊断损失的预测性差. 实践者的主要教训是,表现忠诚、诊断充足性和语言模式能力是不同的特性,因此需要不同的测试。 三个方向跟着。 首先,只应在培训数据中重复设计选择,并在独立的数据集中检查。 第二,在最弱的地方(开放的外振幅插件,Q波等小偏转,以及快节奏),应该改进代表. 第三,语言模型应在ECG-26c文本上进行微调,并按全部上下文计算,与无序符号频率基线进行比较,并通过压缩水平和增益标记测试快捷键. 这些只是计算比较,不足以用于临床。
